en: Yesterday: a snail in a ten metre well. Up three metres every day, and down two metres every night.
So each full day and night, the snail only gains one metre.
After seven days and seven nights, it is at seven metres.
On day eight, it climbs three more metres, and reaches the top!
It is out on day eight! Not day ten!
Person one has two ropes, and a lighter.
Each rope takes exactly one hour to burn. But they burn unevenly, fast in some parts, and slow in others.
There is no clock, no phone, and no ruler.
How can Person one measure exactly forty five minutes?
Comment your answer. The answer drops tomorrow, at sunrise.
